Hi Suzanne —

Thanks again for taking the time on the discovery call last week. A few folks on your clinical AI team expressed interest in a short, focused walkthrough that shows:
- model selection and latency profiles for typical EHR workloads
- private deployment options (VPC / on-prem) and audit log examples
- cost/throughput tradeoffs we’ve seen for similar customers

We can run this as a group walkthrough for the BrightPath cohort — keeps it efficient and helps other teams hear the same details. Proposed slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-07-14 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2026-07-14 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2026-07-15 09:00–09:45

Attached a one-page agenda and a tentative invite (cal-ics). If none of these work, tell me two other windows and we’ll adapt. Ava will co-present the deployment section; Marissa will share a short case study.

Best,
Jonas
